title: Metrics Alert Rule Evaluation Failures in AWS Australia (prod-au-southeast-1)

updates.body: We are investigating an elevated rate of failures when evaluating Metrics alert and recording rules in AWS Australia (prod-au-southeast-1). Some customers may see rules missed or delayed rule evaluations, which can result in missed or delayed alert notifications and gaps in recorded series. Next update by 10:20 UTC.

We continue to investigate intermittent failures when evaluating alert and recording rules in AWS Australia (prod-au-southeast-1), first observed at approximately 08:00 UTC. Some customers may see rules fail to evaluate or be delayed, which can result in missed or delayed alert notifications and gaps in recorded series. We are continuing to investigate. Next update by 11:15 UTC.

Between approximately 08:00 and 09:40 UTC (about 1 hour 40 minutes), some customers in AWS Australia (prod-au-southeast-1) experienced intermittent failures when evaluating alert and recording rules, which may have caused missed or delayed alert notifications and gaps in recorded series. This has been fully resolved and rule evaluation is operating normally.

title: Missing Metrics for Some Synthetic Monitoring Checks using the Montreal, North Virginia, and North California public probes

updates.body:
Between approximately 08:09 and 09:10 UTC on 2 November (about 1 hour 11 minutes), a subset of Synthetic Monitoring checks running from the Montreal, North Virginia, and North California public probe locations experienced missing metrics, which may have appeared as gaps in dashboards. Specifically this affected:

Checks with the Montreal Public Probe from 08:09-09:00 UTC
Checks with the North Virginia Public Probe from 08:22-09:06 UTC
Checks with the North California Public Probe from 08:43-09:20 UTC

This has been fully resolved and all services are operating normally.

title: Elevated Request Errors for Grafana Across Multiple Regions
components: Federal Cloud - AWS US Gov West

updates.body: We are investigating some failed requests affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions, beginning at approximately 12:10 UTC. Customers may see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries, and some requests may time out or be cancelled. Our engineers are actively investigating. Next update by 13:30 UTC.

We have identified the cause of the elevated request errors affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions and are applying mitigation. Customers may still see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries while recovery continues. Next update by 13:30 UTC.
